0022600106.text: The Bucks (0-2, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (2-0, on a two-game winning streak), who lead the Atlantic Division and sit 3rd in the East while Milwaukee is 13th in the East and 2 games back in the Central. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), LeBron James (back), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), all listed as out, while no Bucks players are listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
